about.label: About
about.title: Sales, service and tyres in one place
about.text: Silk Route Mobility is the official importer of ROX and DFSK for the Czech Republic and Slovakia. We sell new cars from both brands in our own showroom. Our workshop and tyre centre look after cars of every make, and for ROX and DFSK that includes warranty inspections and genuine parts.

showroom.label: Showroom
showroom.title: See the cars up close in our showroom
showroom.text: Our showroom has cars from both brands. Open the doors, try the seats, fold the back row. We will walk you through trim levels and prices and answer anything you want to know.

service.label: Service
service.title: Service for every make
service.intro: We service and repair cars of every make. For ROX and DFSK we also carry out warranty service to the manufacturer’s schedule.

rows.name: ROX and DFSK warranty service
rows.text: Inspections and repairs to the manufacturer’s schedule, so your warranty stays valid.

rows.name: Service for all makes
rows.text: Routine maintenance, oil changes, brakes and repairs, whatever you drive.

rows.name: Diagnostics
rows.text: Reading and evaluating fault codes from the control units.

rows.name: Genuine parts
rows.text: Parts for ROX and DFSK straight from the manufacturer.

rows.name: 24/7 assistance
rows.text: For ROX and DFSK owners: if your car stops on the road, we help. Day or night.

tyres.label: Tyres
tyres.title: Wheels ready for every season
tyres.intro: Tyre changes, balancing and alignment for cars of every make.

rows.name: Tyre change
rows.text: Seasonal wheel swaps or tyre changes on rims.

rows.name: Storage
rows.text: We keep your wheels until next season.

rows.name: Balancing
rows.text: So the steering wheel stays still at speed.

rows.name: Alignment
rows.text: Axle alignment. The car tracks straight and tyres wear evenly.

rox.title: ROX
story: ROX builds large SUVs for people who travel. Not for the school run, but for routes where the road turns to gravel and the gravel turns to a river crossing.
ROX cars look square, sturdy and calm. Inside, they offer space and comfort for full days behind the wheel.
Silk Route Mobility brings them to the Czech Republic and Slovakia. We handle sales, service and spare parts ourselves.

models.adamas: An off-road SUV built for expeditions.
models.01: A large SUV for families and long distances.

dfsk.title: DFSK
dfsk.sub: Practical SUVs with a five-year warranty.
story: DFSK makes cars for everyday life. Roomy, sensibly priced and covered by a five-year warranty.
Choose from two petrol SUVs and the E5 plug-in hybrid, which can cover shorter trips on electricity alone.
Silk Route Mobility handles DFSK sales, service and parts as the official importer.

models.500: An SUV for the city and weekends away.
models.600: An SUV for families and longer trips.
models.e5: Plug-in hybrid. Short trips on electricity, long ones with petrol.

sections.p: This website uses no cookies, analytics tools, ad networks or embedded third-party content. It has no forms. We collect nothing about you while you browse.
The server hosting this website may record technical access logs (IP address, time, requested page). They are used only to keep the site running and secure and are deleted after a short period.
If you call or email us, we use your name and contact details only to deal with your enquiry. We do not pass them on to third parties and keep them only as long as necessary.
You have the right to access, correct or erase your data and the right to object. You can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.gov.cz).
